tool_result_content:
**Page last modified date:** The page text doesn't include a last-modified date, so I can't confirm it from this content.

**`concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` semantics:** The page says:

> `Forbid`: The CronJob does not allow concurrent runs; if it is time for a new Job run and the previous Job run hasn't finished yet, the CronJob skips the new Job run. Also note that when the previous Job run finishes, `.spec.startingDeadlineSeconds` is still taken into account and may result in a new Job run.

The policy only applies to Jobs created by the same CronJob. Skipped runs are not queued.

Example:

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: report
spec:
  schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 200
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: report
            image: busybox:1.28
            command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "date; echo Generating report"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
```

**Idempotency and duplicate or missing runs:** The visible portion of the page doesn't include a statement on this. The truncated section probably covers it under "CronJob limitations." From my knowledge of the upstream docs, a CronJob can occasionally create zero or two Jobs for a single scheduled time, so Jobs should be idempotent.
